The yellow phantom tetra, Hyphessobrycon roseus, is a small characid from Suriname, French Guiana and the Brazilian bank of the Oyapock/Oiapoque.
The species originates from French Guyana, where it occurs in the rivers Maroni and Oyapock.

regions.name: Oyapock
regions.quote: This species' range extends eastward from the Courantyne River in Suriname to the Oyapock/Oiapoque drainage which forms a large portion of the border between French Guiana and Brazil.
